summary: Verified fix for console warning 'Received `false` for a non-boolean attribute `accessible`'. Executed 3 scenarios on mobile viewport (390x844): (1) public landing '/', (2) STUDENT login (uitest_167043@test.gr) + navigation across all 5 bottom tabs (Home, Ηχοθεραπεία, Εκπαιδευτικά, Εκδηλώσεις, Profile), (3) ADMIN login (admin@soundhealing.gr) landing on /admin. In every scenario, the exact 'non-boolean attribute `accessible`' warning count was 0. Spiral 'Ηχοθεραπεία' bottom-nav icon renders correctly on all screens (SVG present in tab bar). Admin screen renders ΔΑΣΚΑΛΟΣ badge and stat cards (ΠΕΡΙΕΧΟΜΕΝΟ/ΤΜΗΜΑΤΑ/etc). No new console errors were introduced; error-level message count is 0 across public, student, and admin flows. grep for `accessible={false}` across /app/frontend/src and /app/frontend/app returned zero matches, confirming the source fix.
critical_code_review_comments: SoundSpiral.tsx, PublicHome.tsx (decorative wave Svg), and BrandHero.tsx (ImageBackground) no longer pass accessible={false}; verified by grep and runtime console capture.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded accounts only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pre-existing out-of-scope dev warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/resizeMode deprecation and 'Unexpected text node' on /practice) were explicitly ignored per request. The 'accessible' warning is fully resolved on public, student, and admin flows.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was passing accessible={false} on web-rendered elements (SoundSpiral Svg in bottom nav, PublicHome decorative wave Svg, BrandHero ImageBackground). React DOM only accepts boolean HTML attribute values, so `false` triggered 'Received `false` for a non-boolean attribute `accessible`'. Fix: remove the explicit accessible={false} prop; default behavior keeps elements non-interactive without emitting the DOM attribute.
